notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Big BUG FIXES IN THE GAME, A NEW ENEMY IN THE GAME, AND ALSO THE ENEMIES ARE MORE DANGEROUS AND SMARTER. New map with enemy.
When escaping from the big house, the journey continues. You need to cross the second level, over the bridge and over the hill, you need to unlock the exit door, and to unlock the exit door, the key is in the second house on the meadow, and in the house there is a dangerous grandfather who will try to kill you if you get close to his estate.

notes.title: New update 1.0.4
notes.content: In this update, some game bugs have been fixed, game saving has been fixed and new things have been added.
